entities.name: Kevin C. Rhoades

entities.summary: Kevin Carl Rhoades is an American Catholic prelate who has served as Bishop of Fort Wayne-South Bend in Indiana since 2009. He previously served as Bishop of Harrisburg in Pennsylvania from 2004 to 2009.
